headline: How to breed the Bee Dragon
title: How to Breed Bee Dragon in Dragon Mania Legends | Fire + Wind | DML Breeding Guide
video_script: Want the Bee Dragon in Dragon Mania Legends? Breed two dragons that together carry the Fire and Wind elements. Careful, Fire and Wind can also give you the Smoke Dragon, so you may need a few tries. Tip: higher level and rarer parents give you better odds of a rare dragon. Which dragon should I cover next? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Higher level parents = better rare odds

description: Dragon Mania Legends: breed two dragons that together carry Fire and Wind to get the Bee Dragon. No combination is guaranteed; the same elements can also give the Smoke Dragon. Element combos checked on the DML wiki and the TouchTapPlay breeding guide.
